stem: The head of e-commerce asks: "For each order, which channel was the customer's final touch before buying, and how much revenue does each channel get when that touch takes the whole order?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: All of each order's revenue to its first touch in the window
Each order's revenue split equally across its touches
All of each order's revenue to its last touch in the window
40% to the first touch, 40% to the last, 20% to the middle ones
